verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS auth service with a dashboard, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI probes are machine-readable documentation, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
